newsitem.title: INDIA: India SEBI eases borrowing norms for mutual funds.
newsitem.headline: India SEBI eases borrowing norms for mutual funds.

text.p: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) on Tuesday said it had relaxed borrowing norms for mutual funds.
"In case of mutual funds, SEBI has decided to expand purposes for which mutual fund scheme could borrow from 'only for redemptions' to dividend and interest payments," it said.
Indian mutual funds are now allowed to borrow only redemptions. SEBI said the regulations have now been amended to allow them to borrow for dividend and interest payments.
